faqs.q: What do the 3 quick buttons at the top do?
faqs.a: ⭐ Give extra stars — give a child bonus stars manually. 📋 One-off activity — add a temporary activity for today. 🏠 Day off — pauses the child's schedule for a day (e.g. sick day, holiday).

faqs.q: How do I tick off an activity?
faqs.a: Tap the activity on the child card — it ticks off straight away. Your child can also tick off in their child view.

faqs.q: What is a compact child card?
faqs.a: The child card shows avatar, name, star balance and section pills in compact mode. Expand the card for more details, a schedule link and the pause button.

faqs.q: What is Day off?
faqs.a: 🏠 Day off pauses the child's schedule for the chosen day — perfect when they're ill or on holiday. The child sees the schedule as inactive. Turn the day back on using the same button.

faqs.q: What is paused mode?
faqs.a: Tap the pause icon (⏸) on the child card to pause a child. Activities show as inactive and the child won't earn stars until you resume.

faqs.q: How does my child earn stars?
faqs.a: Each completed activity earns 1 star. Your child ticks off in child view — or you can tick off in Daily log while you're trying things out. Give bonus stars with the ⭐ button above the child cards.

faqs.q: How does the Treasure Chest work?
faqs.a: Your child opens the Treasure Chest via the 💎 tab in child view and sees rewards with star prices. When they've saved enough, they can ask for a reward — you approve it.

faqs.q: How do I add rewards?
faqs.a: Go to Library in the menu → the "Rewards" tab. Add your own rewards, edit the star cost and choose which children see them.

faqs.q: How do I add an activity?
faqs.a: Go to Weekly schedule → choose child → choose day → tap "+" to add an activity from the library. You can search among 63 standard activities.

faqs.q: How do I copy a schedule to every day?
faqs.a: In Weekly schedule → "Copy from…" → choose a source (your own schedule or the standard library) → tick the days you want to copy to.

faqs.q: What is the Today view?
faqs.a: The Overview "Today" view updates automatically when you change the schedule. Changes in Weekly schedule show up straight away on Overview and in your child's view.

faqs.q: How do I invite another grown-up?
faqs.a: Go to Family & settings → Family members → tap "Invite". The person you invite gets an email with a sign-in link.

faqs.q: How do I see my child's day?
faqs.a: Open Daily log in the menu — there you see today's activities as your child will see them. Perfect on the first evening before your child logs in themselves.

faqs.q: How does my child log in?
faqs.a: When you're ready: your child logs in at /child-login with username and PIN. You'll find the details under Family & settings → Children.

faqs.q: Contact support
faqs.a: Email us at [REDACTED] — we reply within 24 hours.

faqs.q: How does the reward system work?
faqs.a: Your child collects stars by completing activities. When their star balance is enough for a reward, they can ask to redeem it — you approve or decline.

faqs.q: How do I add new rewards?
faqs.a: Go to Library in the menu → the "Rewards" tab → search or tap "+ Add reward". You can also copy straight from the standard library.

faqs.q: How do I control per-child visibility?
faqs.a: When you create or edit a reward, you choose which children should see it. Handy for tailored rewards per child.

faqs.q: How do I approve a redemption request?
faqs.a: Your child's request shows on Overview with a badge. Tap to approve. Stars are deducted automatically and your child sees the change straight away.

faqs.q: How does my child earn stars?
faqs.a: Each completed activity earns stars (1 star per activity by default). You can also give bonus stars with the ⭐ button on Overview.

faqs.q: What is star balance vs daily progress?
faqs.a: Star balance = total saved balance. Daily progress (the ring around the emoji) = how many activities your child completed today. These are separate.

faqs.q: What happens when a reward is redeemed?
faqs.a: Stars are deducted automatically from your child's account. Your child sees the change straight away in their Treasure Chest. You see the history on the Rewards page.

faqs.q: How do I add an activity?
faqs.a: Choose day → tap "+" → search and pick an activity. You can choose several time slots at once (Morning + Evening) and the activity is added to all of them.

faqs.q: How do I create a new activity directly in the schedule?
faqs.a: Tap "+" → search → if nothing matches, the "Create new" form appears in the search modal. Fill in name, emoji, star value and any sub-steps.

faqs.q: How do I edit an activity's name or emoji?
faqs.a: Tap the activity's name or emoji in the schedule → the edit modal opens. Changes apply automatically to all children and days.

faqs.q: How do I copy a schedule from another child?
faqs.a: Tap "Copy from…" → choose source → tick the weekdays you want to copy to. Choose whether to overwrite existing content.

faqs.q: Does the schedule sync automatically to child view?
faqs.a: Yes! Changes in Weekly schedule sync straight away to the "Today" view on Overview and to your child's view — no manual updates needed.

faqs.q: What is the standard library?
faqs.a: The standard library has 63 ready-made activities in 6 categories and 5 schedule templates. Tap "Quick insert from library" to add them to the schedule.

faqs.q: How do I copy a standard schedule?
faqs.a: Under the Schedule tab → "Copy from…" → choose "Standard library" → pick a schedule → choose days → copy.

faqs.q: Why can't my child see any activities?
faqs.a: Check that the schedule is set for the right child and that there are activities for today's day. Empty schedule? Copy from the standard library to get going quickly.

faqs.q: How do I build a good routine schedule?
faqs.a: Start with 3–5 fixed activities (breakfast, brushing teeth, homework). Put them in the right order. Children learn the routine quickly when it stays consistent.

faqs.q: What are sub-steps on activities?
faqs.a: You can add sub-steps to activities (e.g. "Wash hands", "Put on pyjamas" under "Evening routine"). Your child sees them as a visual guide but ticks off the whole activity in one go.

faqs.q: How many activities per day?
faqs.a: Recommended: 4–8 activities. Too few and there's no flow; too many and it feels overwhelming. Start small and build up.

faqs.q: How do I add a child?
faqs.a: Go to Overview → tap "+ Add child". Fill in name, emoji and birthday. The child gets a schedule automatically based on age.

faqs.q: How do I change my child's PIN?
faqs.a: Tap the child card → the "Settings" tab → "Change PIN". Choose a new 4-digit PIN.

faqs.q: My child must do activities in order — can I change that?
faqs.a: The default is free tick-off. For guided order, go to your child's profile → the Settings tab → turn on NOW / NEXT / LATER.

faqs.q: How does my child see their login details?
faqs.a: Tap the child card → the "Settings" tab → "Show login details". You'll see your child's username and PIN.

faqs.q: How do I remove a child?
faqs.a: Family → choose child → Settings tab → "Delete child permanently". Note: all schedule, star and reward history is deleted and cannot be undone.

faqs.q: How do I invite another grown-up?
faqs.a: Go to the Family members tab → "Invite". The person you invite gets an email with a link to create an account.

faqs.q: Can I choose which children a grown-up sees?
faqs.a: Yes! You choose which children they can access when you send the invite. You can change it later under Family members → the person → Child access.

faqs.q: How do I remove a family member?
faqs.a: Tap the person in the Family members list → "Remove". They lose access to the family immediately.

faqs.q: How do I change my password?
faqs.a: Go to Settings (⚙️) in the menu → "Change password". You'll need your current password.

faqs.q: How do I turn on notifications?
faqs.a: Go to Settings → "Reminders" → turn on notifications and choose times. Notifications need browser permission.

faqs.q: Contact support
faqs.a: Email us at [REDACTED] — we reply within 24 hours.

faqs.q: What is an activity?
faqs.a: An activity is a task your child does (e.g. "Brush teeth"). Activities earn 1–5 stars and can have sub-steps. Collect them in your library and add them to children's schedules.

faqs.q: How do I create a new activity?
faqs.a: Tap "+ New activity" → fill in name, category (Hygiene, Food, Play, etc.), duration and star value. Save and the activity is added to your library.

faqs.q: How do I add an activity to the schedule?
faqs.a: Activities live in your library. Go to Weekly schedule → choose day → "+" → pick the activity you want to add.

faqs.q: How do I remove an activity from every day?
faqs.a: Tap ✕ on the activity → choose Every day of the week. To remove only today or one weekday (e.g. every Thursday), there are separate options.

faqs.q: How do I edit an activity?
faqs.a: Tap the activity in the list → "Edit". Changes apply straight away in every schedule where the activity is used.

faqs.q: What are categories for?
faqs.a: Categories colour-code activities in child view. Hygiene=blue, Food=yellow, Play=green, School=purple, Movement=red, Rest=grey, Social=orange.

faqs.q: How do I choose a category?
faqs.a: When you create or edit an activity, pick a category from the dropdown. Choose the one that best describes the activity.

faqs.q: Which tabs are in the library?
faqs.a: Schedules — your own schedule templates. Activities — activity library with sub-steps. Rewards — your own rewards. Standard library — 63 activities, 15 rewards and 5 schedules to copy from.

faqs.q: How do I copy from the standard library?
faqs.a: Go to the "Standard library" tab → choose activity or reward → tap the 📥 button to copy to your family library. Schedules are copied via Weekly schedule → "Copy from…".

faqs.q: How do I create a new activity?
faqs.a: Tap "+ New activity" → fill in name, emoji (pick or type your own), star value and any sub-steps → save. The activity is saved in the library for the whole family.

faqs.q: What are sub-steps?
faqs.a: Sub-steps are step-by-step instructions under an activity (e.g. "Wash hands" under "Hygiene"). Your child sees them as a guide but ticks off the whole activity in one tap.

faqs.q: How do I edit an activity?
faqs.a: Tap the activity's name in the schedule — the edit modal opens. Changes (name, emoji, sub-steps) apply automatically to all children and days.

faqs.q: How do I add a reward?
faqs.a: The "Rewards" tab → search for a reward → tap "+ Create new" if it doesn't exist → fill in name, emoji, star price → choose which children see it → save.

faqs.q: How do I search for rewards?
faqs.a: The search box looks in your own rewards AND the standard library at the same time. No matches? The "Create [name]" button opens a pre-filled form.

faqs.q: Can a child have private rewards?
faqs.a: Yes! When you create the reward, you choose which children should see it. Handy for tailored rewards per child.

faqs.q: How do I change my password?
faqs.a: Enter your current password and your new password → tap "Save". The password must be at least 6 characters.

faqs.q: How do I change my email address?
faqs.a: Enter your new email address → tap "Save". You may need to verify the new address by email.

faqs.q: How do I delete my account?
faqs.a: Contact us at [REDACTED] for account deletion. We handle it within 48 hours.

faqs.q: How do I turn on reminders?
faqs.a: Turn on the switch under "Reminders" → choose time and which days. Your browser must allow notifications.

faqs.q: I'm not getting notifications even though they're turned on
faqs.a: Check that your browser has allowed notifications for the site. Go to browser settings → Notifications → find [REDACTED].se → Allow.

faqs.q: What does the calendar show?
faqs.a: The calendar gives a month overview of your child's activities, redeemed rewards and important events.

faqs.q: How do I move between months?
faqs.a: Tap the arrows (< >) next to the month name to change month.

faqs.q: How do I see more detail for a day?
faqs.a: Tap a date to see a detailed list of activities and stars for that day.

faqs.q: What is the daily log?
faqs.a: The log shows your child's day — activities, tick-offs and stars. Use it to preview what your child sees, or to fill in afterwards.

faqs.q: How do I filter the log?
faqs.a: Choose a child in the filter at the top to show the log for one child only. You can also filter by date.

faqs.q: How far back can I look?
faqs.a: The log keeps data from the day you started using [REDACTED]. Scroll or pick a date to see older data. // pragma: allowlist secret

faqs.q: What is "Choose schedule per day"?
faqs.a: Here you choose which weekly schedule is active for each child and day. Handy if you have different routines on weekdays and weekends.

faqs.q: Can a child have different schedules on weekdays vs weekends?
faqs.a: Yes! Pick one schedule for Mon–Fri and another for Sat–Sun. Tap the day and choose the schedule you want.

faqs.q: What happens if no day is assigned?
faqs.a: If no day has a schedule assigned, your child sees no activities that day. Make sure every day you want to use has a schedule assigned.

faqs.q: What can I do in the admin panel?
faqs.a: The admin panel gives you access to all families, users and system data. You can view statistics, manage accounts and moderate content.

faqs.q: How do I find a specific user?
faqs.a: Use the search field at the top to search by email or name. Tap a family to see details.

faqs.q: How do I archive a family?
faqs.a: Tap the family card → "Archive". Archived families can be restored but stay inactive until then.

faqs.q: How do I see incoming support messages?
faqs.a: Under the "Support inbox" tab you see every message sent via the contact form. Tap to read the full text and reply.

faqs.q: How do I mark a case as resolved?
faqs.a: Tap the case → "Mark as resolved". Resolved cases are filtered out of the default view but can be shown via "Show resolved".
